scope: Native spectral prepare/copy and real allocator integration in C
acceptance_target: Hardware-first license-free C firmware; byte identity waived
contract: Prepare requests4*nfft+4 bytes from the actual native allocator; packed input uses existing C5/10 conversion, raw input uses memmove. Native real core executes with the output-pointer slot as explicit legacy incoming-R9 coefficients.

Normalization visits every transform word, using actual C encoded unsigned32-to-double, float-to-double, multiply2, divide and double-to-float helpers. Output pointer is loaded after computation; existing output copies requested words then frees scratch; empty output resizes and publishes scratch.

Copy wrapper uses supplied scratch and live output pointer. Its explicit ninth C argument represents native incoming R9 for legacy non256 calls; the256 core owns its coefficients. No new writable owner, inline assembly or coefficient data.

The fixture executes actual C heap initialization/allocation/reuse/split/resize/free, FFT, memory, packed conversion and math. Fatal/platform ports are guarded and never executed, not modeled as successful returns. Native/C full public RAM includes allocator metadata and live tail words.
